text: Lab 002 didn't hold up as a win. The safe check (S1) passed in both runs, but both efficiency bounds failed: in the follow-up, targeted_a25 cost 1.52x the best baseline against a 0.8 bound, and 1.785x against 1.1 on relevant_only. What it did show is that verification closes the stale-data problem: semantic_trusted had 221 stale op-steps in W2, while targeted_a25 had 0 everywhere except 1 in W3. Separately, agents declared dependencies exactly in 144 of 144 cases, but the runtime verifier caught only 42 of 52 omitted fields, missing collision, tie-breaker and rare-literal reads. One thing is yours to decide: whether to preregister a verifier v2 as its own run, which the write-up recommends rather than tuning against those 10 misses.
